title: Bracing.
officialText:
For the purposes of this section, cripple walls having a stud height exceeding 14 inches
(356mm) shall be considered a story and shall be braced in accordance with Table 2308.9.3(1) for Seismic Design
Category A, B or C. See Section 2308.12.4 for Seismic Design Category D.
